approach: Add a one-file-per-recipe library (metadata docstring + PARAMS block) parsed by a new recipe_files.py and merged into CURATED_RECIPES; replace skeleton_storage with server/local_recipes.py capturing whole snippets keyed by a normalized fingerprint, with one-time legacy migration. One lexical ranker in server/recipes.py feeds new additive recipes keys, flextools_list_recipes, and a deprecated list_skeletons alias; the first batch is ported to flexicon 4.11.0 and verified on Sena 3.

decisions.decision: Keep results[0].recipe on the old first-match function; new ranked scorer only feeds the new recipes key
decisions.rejected: Point the old attachment at the new ranker

decisions.decision: New rows use source shipped|local; internal dict and results[0].recipe keep source curated
decisions.why: Append-only contract and common-patterns/2.0 schema unchanged

decisions.decision: recipe_library is package data read via importlib.resources, never imported
decisions.why: Files reference runner-injected names; keeps pyright/import inert

decisions.decision: Malformed recipe file is skipped+logged; id collision raises at import
decisions.why: Server must start, but a collision can only be a CI-caught packaging bug

decisions.decision: Local store rewritten atomically (temp+os.replace) with tokenize-based fingerprint and 2000-row cap
decisions.why: Repeats update in place; tokenize handles # in strings

decisions.decision: Legacy migration regroups skeleton defs by op_id into one body per run
decisions.why: Restores Main with its helpers; 54% of entries were unrunnable split

decisions.decision: Add first-ever server instructions via build_server(instructions=...), tested under installed mcp
decisions.why: FR-027 names server instructions; none exist today

decisions.decision: PARAMS descriptions from trailing, above-line, or inside-value comments
decisions.why: No harvested script uses trailing comments

decisions.decision: Rebase feat/unified-recipes onto main 2.14.0 before implementing
decisions.rejected: Implement on stale branch or on main

decisions.decision: Rank recipes by weighted term bags (task > code identifiers > object names) with IDF weighting and an alias table
decisions.why: Basic object access is easy to reproduce; recipes earn their place on the task and on hard-to-find calls, and IDF makes common words like entry cheap without a hand-kept list
decisions.rejected: Flat word overlap, or a hard-coded down-weighted object list

decisions.decision: recipes[0] carries code only for a clear winner, and never duplicates results[0].recipe code (code_at pointer); ambiguous queries get compact rows plus recipes_ambiguous and recipes_hint
decisions.why: Avoid spending a code body on a coin flip; SC-005 caps a response at one code body
decisions.rejected: Always attach code to the top row (original FR-021)

decisions.decision: Validator treats a member as deprecated if the flexicon index marks it, as well as the curated list (recipes only; run-time preflight unchanged)
decisions.why: Curated list holds one family while the index has nine deprecated methods; pyright cannot see deprecations with no stubs
decisions.rejected: Pyright reportDeprecated, or hand-adding the methods to the curated list

decisions.decision: FR-045 detect_raw_lcm_access: fail on raw LCM where the inverted bridge index shows a flexicon wrapper; otherwise require a flexicon-gap or raw-lcm note; ratcheting raw_lcm_lines header
decisions.why: Minimal LibLCM, index-driven; flexicon gap fixes automatically flag the recipes to update
decisions.rejected: Comment convention only, or a ban on raw LCM
